Root,entry ABI,epoch and counter domains remain explicit;164 other array sites,236 alias sites,whole control closure,native owners/return and transport pairing remain unproved.

Thirteen UNSAT/six abstract SAT and eight freshness alterations pass. No destination envelope premise is assumed for these ten sites;entry roots,epoch,counters and finite component traversal remain contracts. The164 other array sites,236 alias sites,native control/ownership/return and daemon-kext pairing remain unproved.
